svg.title: Travel prep stacks upward, each tier built on everything below it
svg.desc: Five tiers stacked and narrowing upward. The base applies everywhere: carry a stripped-down device, install and test circumvention tools before leaving, have a second way to connect, use end-to-end encryption for sensitive messages, separate accounts, turn on full-disk encryption, and keep an offline backup. Above it, the low-risk tier covers Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea, where usual tools are fine. The medium tier covers the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Macau, where public Wi-Fi should go through a VPN and local content law is worth reading first. The high tier covers Hong Kong, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, and mainland China, where an obfuscating VPN and Tor bridges should be tested at home and sensitive work kept off the local network. The top tier is Myanmar, where the advice is a stripped-down clean device, no local SIM, and assuming surveillance throughout.
svg.text: Stripped-down clean device, no local SIM, assume surveillance
High risk: Hong Kong, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, mainland China
Obfuscating VPN and bridges tested at home. Clean device. No sensitive work locally.
Medium risk: the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Macau
Route public and venue Wi-Fi through a VPN. Read up on local content and defamation law before you publish.
Low risk: Taiwan (baseline), Japan, South Korea
Close to home. Your usual tools are fine. Bring a passport for a SIM.
Carry the most stripped-down device you can. Install and test circumvention tools before you leave. Have a second way to connect.
Use end-to-end encryption for anything sensitive. Separate your accounts. Turn on full-disk encryption. Keep an offline backup.
Each tier is built on everything below it. The higher the risk, the more you stack on top.
Hong Kong sits in the high tier for a different reason than the other four. Its connectivity is close to the medium tier, and the
threshold is the border: since March 2026, refusing to hand over a device password during a national-security investigation is itself
an offence, for any nationality, including passengers merely transiting. Tiers and country details change; check before you travel.
